author: Daniele Morais
title: Magnitude 6.2 earthquake strikes near South Sandwich Islands region
seoTitle: Magnitude 6.2 earthquake near South Sandwich Islands regio
subtitle: The quake was recorded at a depth of 126 km, according to the US Geological Survey (USGS).
excerpt: A magnitude 6.2 earthquake was recorded near South Sandwich Islands region, at a depth of 126 km, according to the USGS.
contentHtml:
A magnitude 6.2 earthquake was recorded on September 2, 2026 at 08:46 PM (Brasília time) near South Sandwich Islands region, according to the United States Geological Survey (USGS). The quake occurred at a depth of roughly 126 km.

What this magnitude means

Earthquakes between magnitude 6 and 7 are considered strong and are usually felt hundreds of kilometers from the epicenter.

What to expect in the coming days

After a main shock, aftershocks — smaller quakes in the same region — are expected over the following days and weeks, with frequency decreasing over time, a well-established pattern in seismology.

With data from the USGS (United States Geological Survey).
